name: BURN r3 — untamed knots pilot + maniclang + kev diet + cluster dives

lanes.prompt: You are a tamer. The verkle chain has 5,926 UNTAMED knots (carved but uncatalogued). Sample 30 knot files from memory/biography/knots/ (ls, then read 30 spread across dates). For each: knot id/filename, dominant theme (3 words), one-line summary, evidence_lost yes/no, and a proposed category from: biography / doctrine / game / ops / research / ritual. This is a PILOT to calibrate a 5,926-knot taming wave. Structured findings.

You are a radar lane (FETCH-LIGHT: read only the landing page text via your fetch tool ONCE — no deep crawling, this is a re-seed of a lane that timed out crawling). Read https://maniclang.com — the 'maths with music' series. Catalog: episode list/topics, the method (multi-projection + sonification), and 3 estate grafts (we have meters, games with music-speed coupling, a walkable site). Under 800 words.

You are a data engineer. The estate wants to train a small decision-model (Kev: yes/no + choice + score heads) on its own decision ledger. Read a sample of memory/kifu or game kifu rows + watch/inbox/receipts to learn the formats (sample 10 rows each). Then DESIGN the training-row schema: one JSON row example per head (noul / choice / score) using real estate content as the values. This is a PILOT: 10 example rows total, schema-first. Structured findings.

You are a deep-diver. memory/research_packs/ cluster 'misc' holds 58 packs (map: memory/runs/gapwave/rp_clusters.json). Read the misc band files (misc_band1/2/3.md). For each of the 4x3 sub-domains: what it covers, the single most load-bearing artifact, and whether it belongs in the revamped memory/beacon (yes/no + why). Structured findings.

You are a deep-diver. memory/research_packs/ cluster 'memory_engram' holds 22 packs on agent memory semantics (SubtleMemory, inject-vs-silent, RIB round-trip). Read the cluster file memory_engram.md + sample 5 packs. What did this cluster CONCLUDE, what is still open, and which 3 findings should shape the estate's memory revamp (the operator wants memory 'more representative')? Structured findings.

You are a triage lane. watch/inbox/ has 713 active cards; the OLDEST third has never been re-reviewed. List the oldest 40 cards by file date (use ls via your tools). For each of the oldest 20: name, date, one line on what it was, verdict LIVE / OWED / STALE. Count the verdicts. Structured findings, under 1500 words.
